content:
incident-bot: PAGER: Sev2 - east-prod GPU pool 'east-prod-gpu-0' saturated. queue_len=5342, tail_latency=4.1s, throttled_reqs=1200 in last 3m. Autoscaler failing to add nodes (quota/scale-limit). Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/gpu-saturation

miguel: oncall here, seeing steady queue growth, autoscaler logs show 'scale_at_limit' and repeated 429s from queue manager. grabbing metrics now. @aya can you grab the routing table?

aya: pulling route table + recent rollout diff. looks like sticky-routing rules for customer-tier=enterprise are set to prefer east-prod until 80% fill. That prevents spillover.

sara: tagging infra. if we can't scale faster we should allow spillover to west2 and west-eu. i'm +1 manual override. impact: some enterprise customers may see increased latency, but overall throughput restored.

ken: quick note - we have quota cushion in west2 but west2 has a different quantized model variant (int8) which may return slightly divergent outputs for ~2% of prompts. low risk but callout for CS.

miguel: plan: 1) temporarily relax sticky-routing for enterprise to allow 30% spill to west2; 2) evict low-priority background batches in east-prod; 3) bump autoscaler target if quota allows; 4) notify CS + customers. Executing step 1 now.

ops-bot: runbook invoked by miguel: gpu-evacuation-phase-1

miguel: applying steer change:
```bash
# steer 30% of enterprise weight from east-prod to west2 for model:open-llm-1
redwood route set --from east-prod --to west2 --match "customer_tier=enterprise" --percent 30 --reason "emergency-evac"
```

ops-bot: route change applied. new distribution: east-prod 70% | west2 30%. Propagation ETA ~18s.

aya: confirming telemetry: within 40s we see queue_len drop from 5342 -> 2100 in east-prod, west2 inflow increasing. tokens/s balance looks stable.

liz-cs: CS ping - i opened a rapid-notify to affected enterprise customers (acme-corp, novus-ai). told them possible slight output variance and extra latency for requests routed to west2. asked them to DM if they see regressions.

ken: infra note: autoscaler reported "quota_exceeded" when trying to add more GPU instances at 1746001202. I've filed a request with cloud-quotas but that won't be immediate. manual spillover is the safe path.

miguel: step 2 - evict background low-priority jobs in east-prod to free KV cache; running eviction job now:
```json
{"action":"evict","selector":"priority:low","batch_size":200}
```

ops-bot: eviction job started. evicted 180/200 in first pass. reclaiming ~12GB GPU memory.

aya: telemetry after eviction and spill: tail_latency east-prod = 1.8s, queue_len=900, throttled=120 -> improving. west2 tail_latency ~2.5s.

miguel: step 3 attempted: bump autoscaler target from 60->80 nodes but cloud API returns 403 quota_exceeded. can't do more.

sara: noting customer impact: turned off real-time billing aggregation for affected tenants to reduce load; CS notified. please add that change to the incident timeline.

ken: double-checking model compatibility: for requests that hit west2, we will route to quantized variant open-llm-1-q8. fallback policy in code will prefer deterministic outputs if function-calls present. added a short note to the rollout board.

liz-cs: acme-corp support ticket created INC-6791; they reported 6% increased latency on their high-priority route. we offered to pin them to east-prod once it stabilizes.

miguel: handoff: @aya i'm passing pager to you at 1746001300. i will remain available for escalations. current status: spillover active, queue decreasing, autoscaler still limited.

aya: taking pager. i'm monitoring for 30m, will revert steering gradually back to east-prod once queue <200 and sustained for 5m. creating a shortterm dashboard for execs.

ops-bot: oncall-handoff recorded: from=miguel to=aya at=1746001300

sara: post-mit notes: we should change default sticky-routing thresholds in runbook to allow automatic spill at 60% rather than 80% for enterprise-tier to avoid manual ops. also urgent: request quota increase for east-prod. I'll open infra ticket & assign to ken.

ken: opened INFRA-1142 requesting +20 GPU quota in east-prod; flagged as P1. added notes about transient burst protection and autoscaler tuning.

aya: monitoring: at 1746001389 queue_len east-prod=180, throttled=6, west2 inflow steady. marking incident in 'stabilizing' state.

miguel: thanks team. after stabilization please capture exact customer calls and any observed output diffs. small follow-up action items: postmortem owner (sara), infra action (ken), CS outreach (liz-cs).

sara: acknowledged. opening postmortem doc: https://go.redwood/postmortems/1746001123-gpu-evac-telemetry. assign owners and schedule 1h sync tomorrow. :calendar:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=stabilizing, impacted_customers=["acme-corp","novus-ai"], duration_to_stabilize=6m. Please run the post-incident checklist.
